# The scheduling checkbox reads and writes live checked state

Entry 1463 replaces checked-attribute string comparisons and retained UI fallback with checkbox.checked and a Boolean conversion of the calendar property. The accepted save path uses that property only when the disable-capability marker permits changes. The native checkbox has its own label and tooltip; its enabled state also requires autoscheduling support and a selected mail identity. In this checkbox family, recommend using the live checked property for user state and keeping capability gating explicit. This does not justify replacing every DOM attribute API with properties. No keyboard, accessible-name, screen-reader or calendar scheduling operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Calendar scheduling checkbox state.
